title: Wi-Fi Access Point (Home WiFi)
summary: Manages only the Access Point interfaces of the home Wi-Fi on every radio; station/WWAN interfaces are never modified.

items.title: Show current AP status
items.description: Lists every AP interface with its SSID, device, network, encryption and enabled/disabled state.
items.usage_tip: Run it before changing anything to see what is already configured.

items.title: Create / Update Access Point (AP)
items.description: Asks for an SSID strategy (unified or separate per band) and a WPA2 password, then applies it to all radios.
items.usage_tip: The password must be at least 8 characters. Wi-Fi reloads at the end, so clients reconnect briefly.

items.title: Back
items.usage_tip: Existing AP configuration is left untouched.
